hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both sides of the street can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalk
hazards.description: The absence of a paved walkway forces pedestrians to walk on uneven grass or share the travel lane with motor vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the roadway edge block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, especially children, who might attempt to cross.

hazards.name: Undefined Vehicle Access

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or designated walking area, forcing pedestrians into the path of vehicles.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked asphalt and standing water create trip hazards and indicate poor drainage.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which significantly reduces pedestrian safety and visibility during nighttime hours.

hazards.description: The absence of a raised curb at the road edge provides no physical barrier to prevent vehicles from drifting onto the grassy buffer.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Install curbs and landscaping to define specific, narrow driveway entrances, restoring a continuous and protected sidewalk across the commercial frontage.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Decluttering
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk at the corner and relocate utility poles to provide a clear, unobstructed path for all users.

interventions.title: ADA-compliant curb ramps
interventions.description: Install ramps with tactile warnings to ensure the crossing is accessible to all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge island
interventions.description: Add a central island to provide a safe mid-point for pedestrians crossing the wide street.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signage
interventions.description: Install pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint to designate safe crossing points between the residential and commercial areas.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Enhancements
interventions.description: Add street trees and more substantial buffers between the sidewalk and the roadway to improve pedestrian comfort and naturally slow traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Protection
interventions.description: Install bollards or a raised curb to physically prevent vehicles from parking on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the left side of the street to eliminate the current gap.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalk on at least one side of the street to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during dawn, dusk, and nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Use paint or physical barriers to prevent parking near driveways and potential crossing points to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or buffer between the sidewalk and the curb on the left side to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, raised sidewalk across the parking lot frontage to provide a dedicated and protected space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the vehicle access point to the minimum necessary, using curbs to define the entrance and protect the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Wayfinding and Markings
interventions.description: Use high-visibility paint or different paving materials to clearly delineate a pedestrian path through the parking area.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks at intersections or key midblock locations to provide designated crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter
interventions.description: Install a raised curb to clearly define the edge of the roadway and prevent vehicles from encroaching on the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks with corresponding curb ramps to provide a designated and accessible crossing point.

interventions.title: Pavement Markings and Delineation
interventions.description: Use paint or bollards to clearly define parking stalls and vehicle travel lanes, separating them from pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Surface Repair and Drainage Improvement
interventions.description: Repave the area and improve grading to eliminate standing water and trip hazards.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or curb extensions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Provide pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and safety for people walking at night.

interventions.title: Install Curbs
interventions.description: Adding a raised curb would better define the roadway edge and provide a minor physical barrier between traffic and the buffer zone.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion and ADA Ramps
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side and install ADA-compliant curb ramps at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the asphalt to remove cracks and uneven surfaces that pose tripping risks.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk on at least one side of the street to provide a safe pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Installation
interventions.description: Install concrete curbs to physically separate the roadway from the pedestrian zone and manage stormwater drainage.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale lighting to improve safety and security for people walking after dark.
